When the President of the United States threatens genocide against millions of innocent people, Democratic leadership should stand in clear moral opposition — not hide behind procedure.

Video

Last night’s showdown was a clear victory for Iran and a clear defeat for Trump — although he’ll of course frame it as a victory.

Some thoughts on the bigger picture... robertreich.substack.com/p/h…

It’s never been more clear that Donald Trump has completely lost his mind.

It’s our responsibility to call on Congress, the military, and any sane individual in this administration to stop him from committing war crimes against the Iranian people.

Video

Trump has really, seriously, frighteningly lost his mind. 

It won’t happen soon, but if Trump continues to deteriorate, Republicans won’t have any alternative but to remove him from office. Neither will America. robertreich.substack.com/p/t…

Billionaires are crying foul about California's proposed wealth tax.

Don't fall for their fearmongering.

A one-time, 5% tax on their excessive wealth is essential to funding what millions of Californians need — and to preserving our democracy.

Video

Average wage growth for workers is now at the slowest pace in 5 years — and could soon be eaten up by inflation.

Meanwhile, CEO pay continues to skyrocket through the stratosphere.

Imagine what our economy would look like if worker pay grew like CEO pay.

Video

Throughout history, war has always been part of the authoritarian playbook. 

That’s because war allows so-called "strongmen" to feign strength, even if they are operating from a place of weakness. 

This is exactly what is happening to Donald Trump.

Video

Trump is cornered, and he’s going stark-raving mad. Some thoughts on his latest outburst...

robertreich.substack.com/p/f…

Huge election wins in Florida (and another on the horizon in Wisconsin).

Raising taxes on the rich in Washington.

Paid family and medical leave in Virginia.

Even in these Trump times, there's good news to be found.

Video
Friends — This is starting to feel a lot like the Vietnam War. robertreich.substack.com/p/m…

"All we say to America is, 'Be true to what you said on paper.'"

These words — spoken by MLK Jr. shortly before he was killed on this day in 1968 — ring just as true now.

Let's honor his legacy by continuing the fight for social and economic justice.

Video

American workers face an existential threat not only from AI, but unprecedented levels of corporate greed. Trump doesn't seem to care.

Video

Is Trump’s war on Iran the new Vietnam?

Will Pam Bondi’s replacement be even worse than she was?

And what the hell was that Trump speech?

Heather and I break it all down on this week’s Coffee Klatch. Join us:

piped.video/-PIjzxqMeQc

As we approach the 250th anniversary of our independence from the British monarchy, it’s more important than ever to commit ourselves to getting big money out of American politics. robertreich.substack.com/p/t…
There’s always a temptation to celebrate when Trump does something sensible, like firing his Attorney General, Pam Bondi — until you ask yourself why he’s done it... robertreich.substack.com/p/b…

What will be the BIGGEST long-term consequence of Trump's war in Iran?

He promised last night that Iran would "no longer be a threat" and that his objectives are "nearing completion." 

But what happens over the long term? robertreich.substack.com/p/w…

Montana — yes, deep red Montana — has a plan to effectively neuter Citizens United.

No Supreme Court ruling or constitutional amendment needed.

Here's how it works.

A reminder: The Attorney General of the United States should be the people's lawyer, not the president's personal attorney. The Department of Justice should act to protect the public, not the occupant of the Oval Office and his political allies.
Spoiler alert: nothing trickled down.

From time to time, I like to get personal on my Substack. Thanks for following along. 

Today I want to talk about aging...

I turn 80 this year (gulp). https://robertreich.substack.com/p/my-problem-with-aging

Trump won WI by less than 1% in 2024.

Last night, progressive Chris Taylor defeated her GOP-backed opponent by 20 points in the WI Supreme Court race — flipping longtime Republican strongholds and securing a liberal court majority until 2030.

The midterm reckoning is here.
Here's the truth about California's proposed wealth tax that billionaires don't want you to know.
Call me crazy, but we shouldn't have to wake up every day trying to figure out if the president of the United States is trying to manipulate the market or start a nuclear war.

Billionaires are crying foul about California's proposed wealth tax.

Don't fall for their fearmongering.

A one-time, 5% tax on their excessive wealth is essential to funding what millions of Californians need — and to preserving our democracy.

$170 million in bets on the Iran ceasefire were recently placed on Polymarket.

Could some users make bets w/ insider info?

You'd think the government would more closely monitor this, but Trump is stifling regulation of these prediction markets.

His family has a stake in their success, of course.

Remember when Trump fawned over his wealthy donors, calling them “rich as hell” while promising to give them tax cuts?

That's one campaign promise he didn't break.

But everyone else didn't get so lucky. [@itep.org]

My friend @rokhanna.bsky.social is absolutely right.

When the President of the United States threatens genocide against millions of innocent people, Democratic leadership should stand in clear moral opposition — not hide behind procedure.

Tuan Van Bui is the 46th person to die in federal custody under the Trump regime — an all-time high.

Around 70,000 people are still in ICE detention, a majority of whom have no criminal convictions.

Never forget the cruelty Trump continues to inflict at home.
We're living through the doom loop once again.
The Art of the Deal.

Last night’s showdown was a clear victory for Iran and a clear defeat for Trump — although he’ll of course frame it as a victory.

Some thoughts on the bigger picture... https://robertreich.substack.com/p/how-to-defeat-trump-every-time

NYT reporting that under this ceasefire each ship will pay $2M to pass through the Strait of Hormuz. It was $0 before Trump launched this illegal war.

100-130 ships pass the Strait daily.

Trump just gave Iran an extra $100M-$130M per day. Masterful gambit, sir. Impeach and remove this fascist—NOW.

It’s never been more clear that Donald Trump has completely lost his mind.

It’s our responsibility to call on Congress, the military, and any sane individual in this administration to stop him from committing war crimes against the Iranian people.

One man put us in this deadly quagmire. One man is wrecking our economy. One man’s immigration agents have terrorized our communities. One man has ridden roughshod over our system of government.

We said "No Kings" 250 years ago. Congress must say "No Kings" today.

If not, they must be replaced.

The so-called “strongmen” of the current era — Putin, Trump, and Netanyahu — are not leaders.

They can manipulate public opinion and sustain their bases of power, but they have no moral authority.

Real leadership is the opposite of thuggery.

I remember the Vietnam War well. Trump should too — we're the same age.

I was too short to serve and lost good friends in the war. Trump pretended to have bone spurs.

That war was characterized by lies, arrogance, and stupidity.

What's happening in Iran is starting to feel a lot like Vietnam.

Senate Republicans refused to convict Trump after Jan 6.

Republican SCOTUS appointees gave him immunity.

Republicans in Congress today stand idly by as he unleashes death and destruction across the globe.

We are now at the whims of a mad king because GOP leaders have refused to constrain him.

@rokhannausa is absolutely right. When the President of the United States threatens genocide against millions of innocent people, Democratic leadership should stand in clear moral opposition — not hide behind procedure.

It’s never been more clear that Donald Trump has completely lost his mind. It’s our responsibility to call on Congress, the military, and any sane individual in this administration to stop him from committing war crimes against the Iranian people.

Billionaires are crying foul about California's proposed wealth tax. Don't fall for their fearmongering. A one-time, 5% tax on their excessive wealth is essential to funding what millions of Californians need — and to preserving our democracy.

Why does the American tax system favor the wealthy? And how did it get this way? I chatted with Jon Stewart about this back in 2012. Sadly it's only gotten worse since then. We must keep up the fight to fix the system.

Huge election wins in Florida (and another on the horizon in Wisconsin). Raising taxes on the rich in Washington. Paid family and medical leave in Virginia. Even in these Trump times, there's good news to be found.
American workers face an existential threat not only from AI, but unprecedented levels of corporate greed. Trump doesn't seem to care.
Are you tired of winning yet?
Montana — yes, deep red Montana — has a plan to effectively neuter Citizens United. No Supreme Court ruling or constitutional amendment needed. Here's how it works.
Here’s what billionaires don’t want you to know.

53 years ago today, the last U.S. combat troops left South Vietnam, ending America’s direct role in the Vietnam War. I remember seeing this anti-war PSA back then. Its message is sadly still very relevant today as Trump drags us into another unpopular war.
